text:
rachel: uploaded a compact onboarding rail prototype that lives at the top of the dashboard. goal: single-row entry for new users with 3 sample projects + primary CTA. PTAL for wording and mobile hit areas.

owen: looked. Nice space-saving layout. Two quick UX flags: 1) the primary CTA says 'Start' — ambiguous. 2) sample cards have no hover state on touch devices.

jules: for copy, prefer 'Explore a sample' or 'Open a sample project'. 'Start' doesn't communicate what starts.

meera: accessibility: tab order currently moves through hidden decorative images before the CTA. images should be aria-hidden or have empty alt. Also add aria-live region for success messages when a sample loads.

rachel: good catch. I'll mark images decorative where appropriate. Owen — what do you suggest for mobile fallback for hover?

owen: use press states and visible focus styles. for non-pointer devices, rely on focus and active states. also ensure 44px minimum touch targets.

jules: microcopy nit: secondary text under the rail says 'Recommended' — can we make it 'Recommended for you' if we have signal, otherwise just remove. ambiguous recommendations are noisy.

meera: a11y nit: focus ring is a 1px dotted outline right now. make it 3px solid with contrast color. ensure it shows in both light/dark.

product-bot: Prototype uploaded: https://redwood.in/figma/rail/compact-v1 (labels: rail-compact, samples-3, primary-explore).

owen: another thought — onboarding checklist lives in a modal when users click the 'Finish setup' link. modal traps focus but when dismissed focus returns to the rail CTA. confirm restore focus behavior.

rachel: yes we should restore to the same CTA element. I'll add a focus-return anchor.

jules: analytics: add events `onboard.rail.sample_opened`, `onboard.rail.cta_clicked`, and `onboard.rail.dismissed`. we'll segment by org_type and device.

meera: motion: there's a carousel auto-advance set to 5s. make it opt-in; auto-advancing content must pause on hover/focus and have controls. also respect prefers-reduced-motion.

owen: UX trade: if we hide the full checklist behind the rail, power users might miss it. maybe include a tiny link 'Full setup guide' that opens the checklist panel.

rachel: agree. small link under CTA. copy: 'Full setup guide' vs 'Setup checklist' — which is clearer?

jules: 'Setup checklist' more action-oriented. but for marketing 'Full setup guide' reads friendlier. A/B test later.

qa-bot: Automated accessibility smoke tests queued for branch: feature/onboard-rail. Tests include keyboard navigation, color-contrast, and ARIA attributes. Report will post in thread.

meera: one more: for localization, avoid concatenating strings like 'Try {projectName} now' in the component template — use full translations with placeholders.

owen: perf note: inline only the first sample thumbnail, lazy-load the others. reduces TTFB impact on mobile.

rachel: action items: 1) rachel update Figma with aria-hidden images + focus-return. 2) owen add touch/press states and lazy-load spec. 3) meera write a11y checklist and reduced-motion rules. 4) jules add analytics events and copy variants. 5) qa-bot will run tests once PR is open. I'll target a design update by EOD and handoff next sprint.

jules: thanks team. I'll draft copy variants and attach them to the PR.

rachel: thanks all, will post updated prototype link when ready. :sparkles:
